messages.author: 945cdd6601f2fea8
messages.subject: RStan Mac installation error
parts:
Hello,

I tried using Rstan but I get the following error when I follow the GitHub guide:

I'm using a Mac OS X version 10.10.5

"Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! clang: warning: optimization flag '-ffat-lto-objects' is not supported
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-ffat-lto-objects'
ld: warning: directory not found for option '-L/usr/local/lib/gcc/x86_64-apple-darwin13.0.0/4.8.2'
ld: library not found for -lgfortran
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
make: *** [file68b021cdc445.so] Error 1
In addition: Warning message:
running command '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R CMD SHLIB file68b021cdc445.cpp 2> file68b021cdc445.cpp.err.txt' had status 1 "

I made sure that I installed xcode and the command line tools are installed. 

I typed these strings into the command line:

xcodebuild -find make
xcodebuild -find gcc
xcodebuild -find g++
xcodebuild -find clang
xcodebuild -find clang++

And they gave me the path to the command line tool

I assume Rstan isn't finding the the C++ compiler. I do not know how to update that link.

-Devin

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] RStan Mac installation error
parts:
I guess the error happened when you installed RcppEigen from source.  Can you try installing a binary RcppEigen?

Jiqiang
